<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is a food item which restores {{Energy|+|30}} when consumed. Since all the items which can be used to craft {{lc:{{PAGENAME}}}}s lack quality levels it can not be improved by using higher quality ingredients. For more information on preparing food see [[cooking]].

==Recipe==
This recipe can be learned by using [[Recipe sweet baking]], which can be purchased from [[Miss Chain]].
